scene: Playroom floor after a tumble. A low scattered pile of blocks lies at center; Child kneels at screen-right and Peer kneels at screen-left with his shoulders dropped. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot at floor level with both faces and the pile visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Peer shows mild sadness with dropped shoulders and a small pout; Child stays gentle and steady; the sadness eases into hope and a small shared smile.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: The scattered block pile lies at center; Peer kneels with dropped shoulders looking at it; Child kneels facing him.
clips.action: Peer spreads both hands over the pile while telling the news. Child leans toward him and asks his caring question; Peer touches his own chest once, saying he is fine but the tower is ruined.
clips.end: Peer's hands rest on his knees; Child keeps looking at him kindly.

clips.start: Peer's hands rest on his knees; Child keeps looking at him kindly.
clips.action: Child raises one hand high above the floor for how tall it was. Peer pats the pile once, flat-handed. Child picks one block from the pile, holds it up like a little start, and offers his together question.
clips.end: Child holds one block up between them; Peer looks at it, then at Child.

clips.start: Child holds one block up between them; Peer looks at it, then at Child.
clips.action: Peer takes the offered block with both hands. Child picks a second block and places it flat on the rug as the first base piece; Peer adds his block beside it, and they exchange a small hopeful smile.
clips.end: Two blocks sit side by side on the rug as the new base; both children kneel close, gently smiling, with the rest of the pile waiting.
